title: Gold Plus: Differences from Gold Account
summary: This document explains how the “Gold Plus” tier differs from the standard Gold account: it offers 6.0% APY on eligible balances, includes an automatic investment sweep to move surplus funds to investments, provides quarterly financial reviews with a dedicated specialist, and offers a priority support tier for faster routing/resolution.
